intent: Combine a structured governance list on the left with numbered risk items and a call-to-action box on the right.
invariants: two panels split 5:7 (left narrower for list, right wider for risks + CTA)
left panel: kicker title, then role list with accent_2 vertical bars
each role row has bold role name (body style, accent_1) and description (caption style)
right panel: kicker title, then numbered risk items with muted fill
each risk item has a large number (subtitle, bold, accent_2) and risk text (caption)
CTA box at bottom of right panel with accent_1 fill and accent_2 left bar
CTA box has section kicker and when/what rows
when labels in kicker style (accent_2), what text in caption (white)
variables: risk text length (20-80 chars per item)
header bar kicker and title text
